title: Anesthesia Fwd: Wholesaler "Supply Outlook 10/07", Put Electives Back?

fields.to: Brent Halvorsen, CPhT; Dr. Naomi Kessler, PharmD; Dr. Amelia Nordstrom
fields.subject: FW: UPDATE — IV Solutions supply outlook 10/07 — electives back on Fri/Mon?
fields.body:
All,

Did you see this? The OR desk just forwarded it to me. The plant is restarting and we're going to 60%.

I want Friday's and next Monday's electives back on the board today, and I want the KVO restriction lifted in the OR. The schedulers are holding 6 joint patients for Friday and Monday and need to start calling them back. Can I tell them yes before noon? I'll call Brent Halvorsen in five minutes so we can settle this before the 11:00 meeting.

— Lucas Hendrickx

Sent: Wed 10/07/2026 10:36 AM
To: Prairie Ridge Health — Pharmacy Purchasing
Subject: UPDATE — IV Solutions supply outlook 10/07

Valued Customer,

Our supplier reports the plant is restarting in stages beginning this week. Allocations MAY increase toward 60% in a future cycle, subject to review. Current week allocation remains 40%. No change to Thursday shipment quantities.

Your current open-order confirmation is attached.

Allocation Desk
Hospital Accounts — IV Solutions

instructorNote: This is a red herring. The wholesaler email is only an outlook: the attached confirmation still shows 952 NS bags on Thursday at the 40% allocation and nothing released for later cycles, so days on hand stay at 4.3 (Level 3). Watch for the PIM to report that to the DOP and CMO before 11:00, and for the DOP and CMO to tell Anesthesia that electives stay off the board and OR conservation, including the KVO restriction, stays in place until confirmed receipts come in and the Incident Commander's next 8-hour reset.
